entities.name: Rosario Silva de Lapuerta

entities.summary: Rosario Silva de Lapuerta is a Spanish jurist who served as a judge at the European Court of Justice (CJEU) between 7 October 2003 and 7 October 2021 and since 9 October 2018 as a Vice-President of the CJEU.
